title: Champion continuity

questions.text: Does the proposed action preserve or damage a valuable relationship path?

inputs: who the latest messages say owns the step

criteria.text: the active champion stays on the path
criteria.guide: If the champion is active and did not delegate, they are included in this step.

criteria.text: a direct thread is justified by delegation or departure
criteria.guide: A direct thread without the champion is right only if ownership was explicitly delegated or the champion left.

failure_examples: Active champion introduces security lead; agent immediately creates a direct handoff and removes champion from future interaction.
known_exceptions: Champion explicitly delegated ownership or left the process.

labels.label: CHAMPION_INCLUDED
labels.when: The champion stays involved in this step.

labels.label: CHAMPION_BYPASSED
labels.when: The active champion is dropped without delegation or departure.

labels.label: VALID_HANDOFF
labels.when: The champion is not involved because ownership was delegated or they left.

diagnostics.name: champion_bypassed
diagnostics.when: the active champion is dropped without delegation or departure
